title: Delegated admin bridge for support autonomy and safe shortpatch execution
creator: Riya Patel
description: Build a lightweight bridge service that lets first-line support invoke vetted shortpatches (runbooks-as-tasks) through a constrained form-based UI and an API. The bridge enforces RBAC, per-step approvals for high-risk actions, automatic dryrun/preview, and appends cryptographic execution proofs to audit logs. Goal: reduce escalations to engineers for common operational fixes while preserving safety and traceability.
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff — scoped MVP to three shortpatch families: DB connection reset, cache flush+reseed, feature-flag rollback. Identified required RBAC roles and audit fields.

2026-03-04: Architecture review with Reliability — agreed to use ephemeral invocation contexts with limited tokens and a sandboxed execution worker per-tenant. Need to confirm quota model for Dedicated customers.
2026-03-06: Design feedback from PM (Sofia Martinez) — add explicit dryrun toggle and structured preview output to reduce human error. Add acceptance criteria for telemetry events.
2026-03-08: Blocker — integration test failures with internal audit-proxy when attaching execution proof. Jonah investigating signing key rotation behavior.
2026-03-10: Implemented prototype of UI form + API; started end-to-end smoke tests against staging cluster.
acceptance_criteria: Support users can execute at least the three MVP shortpatches via the UI with a preview step
Every execution writes an immutable audit record including a signed execution proof and input snapshot
RBAC prevents non-oncall users from running high-risk actions without a two-step approval
Telemetry emits structured events for start/preview/commit/rollback with correlation ids
Staging E2E tests show the sandbox worker isolates side effects and reverts state on failed dryruns
steps_taken: Auth surface sketched: JWT scopes + tenant-scoped ephemeral tokens
Prototype worker that runs shelllet wrappers in a constrained container built and smoke-tested
Audit-proxy integration POC that attaches signed execution proofs to event streams
UI wireframes for templated shortpatch forms created and reviewed by Support
decisions: Use ephemeral invocation contexts rather than broad service tokens to reduce blast radius
Enforce preview/dryrun as default for all shortpatches; commit must be explicit
Record minimal run inputs in plaintext but store full input snapshots encrypted via KMS
Telemetry schema will follow ops.event.v1 to align with Console dashboards
next_steps: Fix audit-proxy signing rotation issue and add integration tests
Implement approval flow for high-risk actions and wire to SSO groups
Add quota checks and Dedicated-customer capacity gating
Run staged pilot with Support team and collect false-positive/false-negative safety signals
Finalize rollout plan with Console team for per-route dashboards and alerting
